Theme.Label: Color Scheme
Theme.Hint: Pick a palette for all System Director sheets, HUDs and popouts. Click a swatch for an instant live preview; Save & Close to persist.

ThemeFx.Label: Color Scheme v2 (animations & textures)
ThemeFx.Hint: Optional themed textures and click animations layered on top of the base color scheme — ice cracking for Nord Frost, scanline glitch for Sci-Fi, ink press for Mono, etc. Select Off to disable all effects.

WidgetVariants._hint: Visual skin for this widget. Data and behaviour are unaffected.

Settings.EnabledHint: Display a floating action HUD whenever you select a token you own.
Settings.ScaleHint: Resize the floating Action HUD between 50% and 200% of its base size.
Settings.BgOpacityHint: Opacity of the dark panel bar at the top of the HUD. 0 = fully transparent (widgets float without a frame).
Settings.DefaultTransparentHint: Render HUD widgets without their built-in dark backgrounds. The GM can still override per-widget via the droplet button in edit mode.
Settings.ShowFramesHint: Draw the rectangular outline around the HUD panel and around each widget cell. Off by default — widgets float without a frame.
Settings.WidgetShadowHint: Add a subtle dark drop-shadow and radial backdrop behind each HUD widget so they remain readable on bright maps.
Settings.ToggleKeyHint: Show or hide the floating Action HUD (default Ctrl+H).
Settings.ResetKeyHint: Unlock the HUD, recentre it, and (in separate-widgets mode) collapse all floating widgets back to the centre. Default Ctrl+Shift+H.
Settings.SeparateWidgetsHint: Place each HUD widget anywhere on the screen as an independent floating panel, instead of grouping them inside the single HUD frame.
Settings.ResponsivePos: Scale HUD position with screen size
Settings.ResponsivePosHint: When the Foundry window changes resolution (e.g. moving from a 2K monitor to 1080p), proportionally scale the HUD bar position and floating-widget positions to stay in the same relative spot.
Settings.ConfigMenuHint: Configure which actor widgets appear in the floating HUD, and where (GM only).

Notify.PositionReset: Action HUD position has been reset.

Cell.ScaleHint: Per-widget scale (25–400%). 100% = no scaling. Applied in addition to the global HUD scale.
Cell.HideLabelNAHint: Inventory, Spellbook, and Effects widgets show their label inside a dropdown trigger, so it cannot be hidden separately.
Cell.VariantHint: Use this widget's variant in the Action HUD instead of the one set on the actor sheet. "Use sheet variant" inherits whatever variant is configured on the sheet.
Cell.VariantNAHint: This widget type has no selectable variants, or this entry is an inline widget that already carries its own variant.
